artifact.canonical_name: Scaling the Horizon, Not the Parameters: Reaching Trillion-Parameter Performance with a 35B Agent

sources.title: Primary source 1: http://arxiv.org/abs/2606.30616v2
sources.role: Primary source used for chronology and technical verification

claims.text: The authors present Agents-A1, a 35B MoE agent intended to scale capability through longer and more heterogeneous agent trajectories.

limitations.text: The evidence is the authors' arXiv paper/model card and reported evaluations; results are not independently reproduced in this Evidence review.

targets.target: verify model identity, benchmarks and comparison basis
targets.finding: Agents-A1 is described as a 35B MoE agent trained with long-horizon trajectories averaging 45K tokens and compared against much larger models across multiple agent benchmarks; the trillion-parameter-performance framing is an author claim rather than an independent result.

editorial.why_now_note: This June paper is technically valid but is retained as supporting/Paper Watch material unless Candidate Selection has room.
editorial.rationale: Primary-paper evidence is valid but lower priority than stronger June themes.
